title: Deterministic resource-manifest refresh
authorized_scope: Preflight inspection confirmed that the public package exposed serialization, deserialization, manifest validation, explicit-root resolution, and hashing, but no ActionObject or CLI refreshed selected manifest identities; this slice therefore does not duplicate maintained behavior.

The public request, result, and action are placed in `resources.py` because they operate directly on the existing `ResourceManifest`/`ResourceReference` hierarchy and reuse that module's private confinement observation; a separate module would split one cohesive resource-maintenance boundary.

`ResourceManifestRefreshRequest` accepts one explicit absolute `pathlib.Path`, one exact existing `ResourceManifest`, and a nonempty resource-ID tuple canonicalized to sorted unique storage. `ResourceManifestRefreshResult` owns success/failure consistency, sorted changed IDs, and deterministic `ValidationResult` diagnostics. `RefreshResourceManifest` resolves only selected manifest-declared `ResourcePath` values beneath the supplied root, reuses maintained exact-case, nonsymlink, root-confined regular-file observation, computes SHA-256 from exact bytes, and returns a new canonically ordered manifest. It preserves all manifest fields and every nonidentity `ResourceReference` field and returns no partial manifest on failure.

It reads only explicit inputs, deserializes through `DeserializeJsonRecord`, invokes the public ActionObject, serializes successful proposals through `SerializeJsonRecord`, emits deterministic JSON, and never writes the manifest.
completion_criteria: The chain `active_task` is restored to `null`. The completed Slice 4 baseline is unchanged. Slice 5 (`resolve-human-checkpoint`), `develop-harness-resources`, review-dispatch idempotency, delegation validation, evidence/SQLite, scientific work, and protected execution remain inactive and unauthorized.
exclusions: Focused software-verification evidence covers request and result invariants, changed/unchanged and multiple selections, SHA-256 exact bytes, deterministic failures, maintained path confinement, nonmutation, CWD independence, repeatability, public imports, and command/API agreement. Focused existing resource-manifest tests, Ruff, focused mypy, canonical JSON round trips, controlled resource validation, and `git diff --check` are the completion gates.

Completed focused validation: 56 selected new/existing resource, serializer, CLI-agreement, and public-API tests passed; the final new/public subset passed 36 tests; focused maintained test-evidence structure passed with 4 modules, 17 evidence owners, and no findings; Ruff format/lint passed; focused mypy passed for 8 files; public imports, controlled refresh, and canonical JSON round trip passed; and `git diff --check` passed. Full pytest, full mypy, Sphinx, package builds, replay, scientific validation, numerical verification beyond exact hashing, UQ, and independent review were not run.

These checks establish only the documented deterministic software contract. A refreshed hash does not establish resource semantics, provenance truth, scientific validity, uncertainty quantification, human acceptance, or authorization to write a maintained manifest.
